title: DISC SANDERS AND DIE GRINDERS-3M™ – Die Grinder
description: 3M™ Disc sanders for metalworking have a high output motor, directional exhaust, 3M™ Greptile grip, 97 degree 3M™ head vs. 90 degree and direct mount for use with 3M™ Roloc™ backup pads. 3M™ Die Grinders are designed to efficiently handle all your cylindrical polishing, buffing, shaping and de-burring needs.
